snippet.title: Appetite of the Abyss - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4100620/Appetite_of_the_Abyss/?utm_source=youtube

A survival cooking roguelite where your tribe’s fate depends on feeding an abyssal creature, learning its tastes through cooking, building with cards, and choosing forecasted paths to prepare for growing threats.
